card.name: Small linking words before a named drug or entity
card.fires_on: Small linking words (of, to, with, and, on, other) or an opening parenthesis that sit right before a specific named drug, agent, organization or place. Often seen in 'use of', 'hypersensitivity to', 'in combination with' phrases.

modes.label: Linking word before a drug name
modes.description: Of, to, with, other or and right before a named drug or drug class in label warnings and combination-use statements.
